def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):

    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

lib=f'''"""Reusable grid functions for ARC tasks."""

def find_separators(grid):
    """Indices of rows that are one nonzero color throughout."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]

def separator_columns(grid, sep_rows):
    """Columns holding the separator color outside separator rows."""
    sc = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    return sorted({j for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row)
                   if i not in sep_rows and v == sc and sc is not None})

def segments(start, end):
    """Half-open column ranges between separator indices in [start, end)."""
    segs = []; prev = -1
    for c in start + [end]:
        if c - 1 >= prev + 1: segs.append((prev + 1, c))
        prev = c
    return segs

def shape_color(grid, sep_rows, band_colors):
    """The color used in a small stamped shape: the nonzero color not in band_colors."""
    from collections import Counter
    sc = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0 and v != sc)
    return [c for c in cnt if c not in band_colors][0]

def pattern_of(grid, color):
    """Bounding-box 0/1 pattern of cells of the given color."""
    cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(i for i, j in cells); c0 = min(j for i, j in cells)
    rh = max(i for i, j in cells) - r0 + 1; cw = max(j for i, j in cells) - c0 + 1
    return [[1 if grid[r0 + a][c0 + b] == color else 0 for b in range(cw)] for a in range(rh)]

def stamp_pattern(grid, pat):
    """Stamp the 0/1 pattern into every column segment of every band, recolored per band."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = find_separators(grid)
    sc = grid[sep[0]][0]
    scols = separator_columns(grid, sep)
    segs = segments(scols, W)
    bands = []
    prev = 0
    for s in sep + [H]:
        color = next(v for i in range(prev, s) for v in grid[i][0:scols[0]] if v != 0)
        bands.append((prev, s, color)); prev = s + 1
    rh, cw = len(pat), len(pat[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, re_, color in bands:
        for cs, ce in segs:
            for a in range(rs, re_):
                for b in range(cs, ce):
                    out[a][b] = color if (a - rs < rh and b - cs < cw and pat[a - rs][b - cs]) else 0
    return out
'''

lib='''"""Reusable grid functions for ARC tasks."""

def find_separators(grid):
    """Indices of rows that are one nonzero color throughout."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]

def separator_columns(grid, sep_rows):
    """Columns holding the separator color outside separator rows."""
    sc = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    return sorted({j for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row)
                   if i not in sep_rows and v == sc and sc is not None})

def segments(start, end):
    """Half-open column ranges between separator indices in [start, end)."""
    segs = []; prev = -1
    for c in start + [end]:
        if c - 1 >= prev + 1: segs.append((prev + 1, c))
        prev = c
    return segs

def shape_color(grid, sep_rows, band_colors):
    """The color of the small stamped shape: the nonzero color not in band_colors."""
    from collections import Counter
    sc = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0 and v != sc)
    return [c for c in cnt if c not in band_colors][0]

def pattern_of(grid, color):
    """Bounding-box 0/1 pattern of cells of the given color."""
    cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(i for i, j in cells); c0 = min(j for i, j in cells)
    rh = max(i for i, j in cells) - r0 + 1; cw = max(j for i, j in cells) - c0 + 1
    return [[1 if grid[r0 + a][c0 + b] == color else 0 for b in range(cw)] for a in range(rh)]

def band_colors_from_first_segment(grid, sep_rows, sep_cols):
    """(start, end, color) for each band, reading its color from the leftmost segment."""
    bands = []; prev = 0
    for s in sep_rows + [len(grid)]:
        color = next(v for i in range(prev, s) for v in grid[i][0:sep_cols[0]] if v != 0)
        bands.append((prev, s, color)); prev = s + 1
    return bands

def stamp_pattern(grid, pat):
    """Stamp the 0/1 pattern into every column segment of every band, recolored per band."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = find_separators(grid)
    scols = separator_columns(grid, sep)
    segs = segments(scols, W)
    bands = band_colors_from_first_segment(grid, sep, scols)
    rh, cw = len(pat), len(pat[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, re_, color in bands:
        for cs, ce in segs:
            for a in range(rs, re_):
                for b in range(cs, ce):
                    out[a][b] = color if (a - rs < rh and b - cs < cw and pat[a - rs][b - cs]) else 0
    return out
'''

from lib import find_separators, separator_columns, shape_color, pattern_of, stamp_pattern

    bands = band_colors_from_first_segment(grid, sep, cols)
    col = shape_color(grid, sep, {c for _, _, c in bands})
    return stamp_pattern(grid, pattern_of(grid, col))
'''
